scientific_question: Can definition-complete NPR explain normalized Mach-disk position across compatible underexpanded-jet conditions?
conditioning_variables: nozzle geometry; gas species; ambient state; formation/instantaneous/overshoot/stabilized state
normalization: x_MD divided by documented exit diameter
required_definition_matching: numerator/denominator roles, pressure type/location/time basis, D basis, and transient state
main_limitation: definition-complete overlap and transient qualifiers reduce the usable subset
recommended_action: Proceed only after case-level eligibility audit; otherwise use TAB-02.

scientific_question: Can event-aligned injector pressure history be related to Mach-disk formation, motion, and stabilization time?
conditioning_variables: valve opening; nozzle; ambient; gas; diagnostic time zero
normalization: event-aligned time; optional x/D only when D basis verified
required_definition_matching: pressure role/type/location, valve event, time reference, and Mach-disk state
eligible_case_count: NV—time histories require curve/data availability audit
expected_plot_type: aligned normalized timelines or small multiples
main_limitation: few machine-readable matched histories and heterogeneous event alignment
recommended_action: Prefer conceptual/event schematic unless source data support a conditioned subset.

scientific_question: How do incident/local Mach context and definition-complete We relate to deformation or breakup response?
candidate_x_parameter: M_s or M_rel with definition-complete We
conditioning_variables: d0; Oh; liquid; loading duration; response stage
normalization: source-defined deformation/time scaling retained; categorical response if incompatible
required_definition_matching: Mach frame/state; We velocity/density/length/surface tension; event and loading history
expected_plot_type: conditioned regime map or faceted response plot
main_limitation: response definitions and reacting/inert histories differ
recommended_action: Use categorical/conditioned map unless a definition-matched numeric subset is adequate.
notes: Do not collapse detonation and inert cases by leading Mach alone.

scientific_question: Does typed loading duration relative to a defined response time organize breakup timing or state?
normalization: candidate ratio only when both time definitions are explicit
required_definition_matching: loading start/end events and response-time event/scale
expected_plot_type: hypothesis test or qualitative duration-domain map
main_limitation: candidate metric is not literature-established and interval definitions are heterogeneous
recommended_action: Retain as a testable research metric; do not present a pooled correlation.

scientific_question: How does droplet size condition breakup and evaporation response under matched wave and thermal states?
candidate_y_parameter: breakup event/mode, evaporation time/length, or survival
conditioning_variables: Mach/We; liquid; gas temperature; post-wave history; detection threshold
normalization: SI size plus source-typed response; within-domain characteristic scaling only
required_definition_matching: initial versus fragment size; statistic; response event; liquid and gas history
eligible_case_count: NV—requires separation by application and response
main_limitation: cross-domain pooling would mix thermal histories and response meanings
recommended_action: Proceed as separate conditioned panels or TAB-05/TAB-07, not one universal curve.

scientific_question: How do spacing and cloud descriptors affect shielding, channel closure, or shock attenuation?
conditioning_variables: tandem/parallel/cloud arrangement; d0; We; shock strength; fragmentation model
normalization: retain descriptor type; no conversion of volume fraction to S/D
required_definition_matching: arrangement, spacing basis, cloud statistic, response definition
expected_plot_type: separate configuration panels or categorical mechanism map
main_limitation: descriptors and mechanisms are non-equivalent across configurations
recommended_action: Use FIG-05/TAB-04 qualitative synthesis unless each configuration has sufficient matched cases.

scientific_question: How does signed pilot/main injection chronology relate to mixture or ignition response?
candidate_y_parameter: ignition delay, ignition location, mixture metric, or combustion-mode response
conditioning_variables: fuel order; geometry; ambient T/O2; load; event definitions
normalization: preserve sign and event identities; convert crank angle/time only with speed and matching events
required_definition_matching: both SOI events, sign convention, ignition definition, operating point
main_limitation: different fuel sequences, geometries, and ignition metrics prevent unconditional pooling
recommended_action: Build conditioned quantitative panels only; use TAB-06 for heterogeneous cases.
notes: Direct timing evidence must not be attributed to shock.

scientific_question: Does a typed evaporation-to-detonation/reaction/refill length ratio organize RDE behavior?
candidate_y_parameter: wave speed deficit, multiplicity, stability, extinction, or unburned pocket metric
conditioning_variables: fuel; chemistry; geometry; pre-vaporized fraction; wave number; scale definitions
normalization: retain source ratio and both length definitions
required_definition_matching: evaporation length criterion and named detonation/reaction/refill scale
main_limitation: typed ratios differ and are not validated for HPDI
recommended_action: Use within-domain conditioned synthesis; do not pool or remap to HPDI.

scientific_question: Can generic reported NPR values be pooled against shock metrics?
required_definition_matching: missing pressure roles/types/time basis makes matching impossible
recommended_action: Exclude; use QSA-01 or qualitative context.
notes: Definition standard is not relaxed for plot density.
